meta.title: CTFPilot CTF Solving Workbench
meta.description: Local dual-channel CTF solving engine as a DSH plugin. The main panel has six fixed tabs: Start Solving / Solving / Tools / Knowledge / Library Refinery / System Evolution. Knowledge merges the old overview, challenge ledger, detectors and lesson cards (sub-tabs: Challenges / Lessons / Engine Signals); Library Refinery only refines library assets (cross re-drill exam, batch re-drill, practice ledger); System Evolution only evolves the harness itself (plugin & preset checkup, RSI proposals, research queue). Ops additions: /ctf-doctor one-shot checkup and the structured ctfpilot-ops.log.
